test.create_query: CREATE TABLE perf_documents ( document_id UInt32, sorted_feature_ids Array(UInt32) ) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE perf_feature_requests ( document_id UInt32, feature_id UInt32 ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO perf_documents SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> toUInt32(number + x * 17), range(32768)) FROM numbers(4096)
INSERT INTO perf_feature_requests SELECT number, toUInt32(number + (32767 - (number % 1024)) * 17) FROM numbers(4096)
test.query: SELECT sum(indexOfAssumeSorted(d.sorted_feature_ids, r.feature_id)) FROM perf_documents AS d INNER JOIN perf_feature_requests AS r USING (document_id) FORMAT Null
